text:
Riley Tran: Heads-up: final launch checklist for Q3 multi-asset push. Deliverables: 1) SEO keyword map for blog + benchmarks 2) JSON-LD for blog (Article) and webinar landing (Event+Offer+FAQ) 3) internal links plan (anchor text + target priorities) 4) redirect rules for legacy pages. Can the squad turn around in 36h?
Hannah Ortiz: Yep. I'll run keyword intent buckets and surface 10 priority KW per asset. Lean to commercial-intent longtails like 'reduce inference cost per token' and 'serve llm low latency'.
Marco Silva: I'll draft anchor text pairs. Proposal: use natural phrases not exact-match heavy. Example links: blog -> "benchmark results" -> /benchmarks/launch-q3, blog -> "how we reduced latency" -> /docs/latency-tips.
Eve Park: JSON-LD note: include same publisher.name and same logo URL on both blog + webinar. For Event object, set attendanceMode: "OfflineOnline"? We should mark as OnlineEvent with startDate 2025-11-12T16:00:00Z. Also add registration url and sameAbout for brand consistency.
Riley Tran: Also confirm canonical strategy: canonicalize paginated benchmark pages to /benchmarks/ if we fold later. For A/B test of blog copy use rel=canonical pointing to /blog/launch-v2 as control.
Marco Silva: Redirect preferences: 301 for moved content, 302 for flash promos. Draft rules (apache style):
```apache
# moved benchmark index
RedirectPermanent /old-benchmarks /benchmarks/launch-q3/
# temporary promo landing
Redirect /promo/launch-cta /events/webinar-launch-2025?utm_campaign=launch_q3
```
Hannah Ortiz: Keywords seed I'm pushing to the doc: ["llm inference cost reduction", "low latency inference techniques", "gpu inference batching", "dedicated inference pricing"]. Will mark primary/secondary.
Eve Park: I'll attach JSON-LD snippets to the PR. Quick sample for Article: 
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Article","headline":"How we optimized LLM inference costs","publisher":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference","logo":{"@type":"ImageObject","url":"https://redwood-internal.company/assets/logo.png"}},"datePublished":"2025-11-11T12:00:00Z"}
```
Riley Tran: For internal linking targets, aim for 2 contextual in-body links in opening 300 words and 1 CTA footer link to webinar + benchmark. Keep anchor variety.
seo-bot: Scheduled site crawl 2025-11-13T02:30:00Z. Will post broken links + redirect coverage in #marketing as a thread reply.
Marco Silva: I'll produce a CSV with [source_path,target_path,redirect_type,notes] and share in /drive/launch/redirects.csv by EOD today.
Hannah Ortiz: Timeline agreed: keyword map + anchor plan by tomorrow noon, JSON-LD by tomorrow EOD, redirects CSV by EOD. Ping me if the CMS slug changes.
Riley Tran: Thanks team. Once JSON-LD snippets are in PR, QA will validate with Google Structured Data testing tool. :shipit:
